gloss: to be hungry; to get hungry (casual)

definitions.gloss: to be hungry; to get hungry
definitions.explanation: A casual, direct expression meaning to feel hungry. Literally 'stomach diminishes.' More blunt and masculine-leaning than the polite form.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{腹|はら}{減|へ}った⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I'm already hungry, so let's eat soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧てない⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I haven't eaten anything since morning, so I'm starving.

notes:
A casual way to say 'I'm hungry,' typically used in informal conversation. The past tense {腹|はら}{減|へ}った is the most common form. Often used without the particle ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ between ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ and ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ in very casual speech, though ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ is the grammatically complete form.

REGISTER:
Casual and somewhat rough. More common in male speech and among close friends. Women and speakers in polite contexts tend to prefer {お腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}いた or {お腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}きました.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹|はら}{減|へ}った: I'm hungry (most common form)
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be starving; unbearably hungry
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦|いくさ}→戦：28574_ikusa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できぬ→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: you can't fight on an empty stomach (proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {お腹|なか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}く: to be hungry — polite, gender-neutral
- ⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧: hunger — formal noun form
